recomputePlanSummaryOnPlanRowChange.description: Palantir-style local Automation: when a DeliveryPlanRow changes, recompute the project's plan summary and surface it as an advisory suggestion (read-only, no auto-write).

displayMetadata.displayName: 计划行变更后重算项目概要
displayMetadata.description: 交付计划活动行被修改后，自动以只读方式重算该项目的计划概要作为建议值；不自动写回，遵循派生→人确认红线。

surfaceEmergentRisksOnPlanRowChange.description: Palantir-style local Automation: when a DeliveryPlanRow changes, re-derive the project's emergent risks (blocked gates, unscheduled activities) and surface them as advisory suggestions (read-only, no auto-write).

displayMetadata.displayName: 计划行变更后浮现涌现风险
displayMetadata.description: 交付计划活动行被修改后，自动以只读方式重算该项目的涌现风险作为建议值；连通决策层派生与建议通道，不自动写回。
